meta.title: V15 Target State Gap Analysis
meta.method: Target state (V15 Prompt v5.0 Enhanced) vs. current repo code inventory
meta.evidence_standard: COMPLIANT = typed artifact + contract + enforcement + test + runtime wiring | PARTIAL = some layers exist but incomplete | MISSING = no evidence | FAIL = contradicts invariant

summary.critical_finding: V15 types/contracts/tests exist but ZERO runtime integration — no agent heal() method or execution path imports or uses any V15 contract. The entire V15 surface is a parallel, disconnected compliance layer.

gap_categories.B_CONTRACT_ENFORCER: Builder / validator / enforcement function exists in enforcement/v15_*.py or types/v15_*contracts.py
gap_categories.D_RUNTIME_WIRED: Actually imported and used by agent heal() paths, orchestrators, or execution pipelines
gap_categories.E_CI_ENFORCED: CI workflow or guardian script enforces this invariant on every push/PR

cross_cutting_gaps.title: ZERO runtime integration of V15 contracts
cross_cutting_gaps.description: The entire V15 compliance surface (types in v15_*.py, contracts in v15_*contracts.py, enforcement in v15_p*_contracts.py) is NEVER imported or used by any agent, orchestrator, or execution pipeline in agentic_core/L0-L6, apps_rg/, apps_lic/, or apps_shared/. The V15 types are consumed ONLY by: (1) other V15 contract files, (2) tests/guardian/test_v15_* test files, and (3) V15ExecutionGateway. No production code path exercises these contracts.
cross_cutting_gaps.evidence: grep for 'from agentic_core.L0_maintenance.types.v15' in agentic_core/ returns only v15_* self-references and v15_contracts.py. Zero hits in apps_rg/, apps_lic/, apps_shared/.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No CI enforcement of V15 invariants
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No GitHub Actions workflow enforces V15 contract compliance. The guardian-tests.yml runs tests but does not gate on V15-specific invariant coverage. The wall-clock AST scanner, forbidden input checker, adapter prohibition, and MRO verifier are all unconnected to CI.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: Dual GuardianArtifact schema conflict
cross_cutting_gaps.description: guardian_contract.py::GuardianArtifact (type/path/description) conflicts with v15_p5_types.py::SignedGuardianArtifact (trace_id/signature/prestaged_perms/environment_metadata/commit_hash/pass_fail). The runtime uses the former; the V15 spec requires the latter.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: Missing typed artifacts: HEALING_PLAN, StaleWriteIncident, SideEffectRegistry
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Three artifacts referenced in the V15 spec have no typed dataclass: HEALING_PLAN (§2.8), StaleWriteIncident (§2.5 step 5), SideEffectRegistry (§12.2). HEALING_PLAN is referenced in a comment only. StaleWriteIncident appears only as a string constant in HEALER_PIPE_ORDER.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: Discovery JSON schema incomplete for V15 audit
cross_cutting_gaps.description: The V15 audit requires discovery JSON with fields: identity, layer, status, file_path, class_name, mro_chain, mixins, detected_methods, integrity_hash. The forensic_discovery_prep.py script exists but the output schema has not been verified to include mro_chain, mixins, integrity_hash fields.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No human review/escalation flow exists
cross_cutting_gaps.description: The V15 spec defines a human escalation path (EvidencePack, ternary resolution, SignedModify, PolicyUpdateProposal, PolicyExceptionArtifact). All types and builders exist but no human-in-the-loop flow is implemented. There is no UI, CLI, or API for human review.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: V15 types located under L0_maintenance/types/ — potential layer violation
cross_cutting_gaps.description: All V15 types and contracts are centralized in agentic_core/L0_maintenance/types/ and enforcement/. Some artifacts (e.g., SignedGuardianArtifact, EvacuationProtocol, CognitiveDiffBundle) are architecturally associated with L5 or L6 but are defined in L0. This may be intentional (L0 as shared foundation) but conflicts with strict layer boundary semantics.
